title: Correction exponents in the chiral Heisenberg model at $1/N^2$: singular contributions and operator mixing
summary: We calculate the correction exponents in the chiral Heisenberg model in the $1/N$ expansion. These exponents are related to the slopes of $β$ functions at the phase transition point. We present the results at order $1/N^2$ and check that they agree with the results of the $ε$ expansion near $d = 4$. We find that one of the correction exponents diverges as $d \to 3$. We argue that the appearance of the pole is a rather general phenomenon and is associated with operator mixing involving the system of four-fermion operators.
